scope: Theorem 8.4 (A separate one-unit loader on the torus) of the manuscript “Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation” (preprints/Incompressible-Box-Transport-and-Finite-Computation-October-6-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2505dc09d3f2c24b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every machine and finite input and every fixed computable ν > 0, there is an effective smooth mean-zero force, one-periodic for t ≥ 1 with bounded mixed derivatives, whose unique smooth zero-data solution with zero normalized pressure satisfies ∃t ≥ 0 : Φt(1/2, 1/2, 1/4) ∈ (1/16, 1/4) × T2 ⇐⇒ halting. Uniqueness holds in the classical class of Section 2.
